body:
The Audit settings page combined a long explanation with an optional Axiom field. It now keeps the requested authority/privacy warning in one notification box and offers **Axiom** or **Custom**.

Axiom requires a dataset; Custom hides and excludes it. Both use Bearer authentication. Switching choices preserves edits. Save, saved-destination Test, encrypted credentials, tenant checks and revision checks keep their existing service behavior. Existing None-auth rows remain readable, but any form Save—including disabling export—and Test require an explicit Bearer upgrade. Old open forms must be reloaded.

[Desktop preview](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/axiom-1200.png) · [Narrow Custom preview](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/custom-320.png)

## Review

**T1 Team review** — Architecture: **T0: no architecture fact**. The separate reason is `impact.sensitiveBehavior`: the local credential form and its page-specific script policy change.

Architecture facts (candidate [e77c075c](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/e77c075c3f8e37874dd89474e8a5f4f784f23e67) against [a7411fd0](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/a7411fd02aa6dd3300b334d4585f71469071b499)):

- None. All 48 public declaration snapshots and all 13 registry diagrams are unchanged.

Why ([impact declaration](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e77c075c3f8e37874dd89474e8a5f4f784f23e67/.pr-impact.json)): the existing web owner maps the selector into the current optional dataset field. Only Audit receives the fixed script's CSP hash. No service contract, database migration, sender, dependency, container or deployment change is needed. Production architecture is unchanged; the registry prose and active plan describe the revised form.

**Merge status: blocked pending independent owner/team approval of this candidate.** Required local checks passed; the three retained MI goal misses and test-only review finding are documented. The checker has zero technical blockers. Earlier PR #248 approval does not cover this change. No new legal-document bytes or live destination settings changed.

## Validation

Later commits change only compatibility prose and the required immutable base metrics record; source, tests, scripts and build/dependency inputs are identical. [Complete evidence index](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/README.md) · [Machine summary](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/validation-summary.json).

| Selected check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `npm test` through pinned Node 24.20.0 | 4,759 backend + 49 portal tests passed; zero failures/skips |
| `npm run typecheck` / `npm run build:user-portal` | Passed |
| Audit Collector runtime files, after the clean build | 10 passed; real isolated TLS/Collector, including revised browser Test and hosted journey |
| Self-hosted container file with `THERMUS_CONTAINER_GATE=1`, after the clean build | 11 passed |

The container/runtime files used their dedicated Node invocations after the complete clean backend build. The hosted image itself runs `npm run build:hosted`; a duplicate standalone `check` or hosted build was not added. [Hosted build log](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/hosted-build.log) · [Image result](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/hosted-image.log).

BDD acceptance failed before implementation, followed by focused form/page red-green tests. Final focused batch: 109 passed. The first ordinary build found a new test table's inferred optional-undefined typing; explicit string-record typing fixed it, the 11 acceptance cases and build typecheck passed, then the full ordinary suite passed. [Failure/retry and TDD record](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/implementation.md). No assertions or deadlines were weakened.

[Real Chromium proof](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/browser-check.json) checks the exact warning, required Axiom dataset, Custom omission, keyboard switching/edit retention, hidden token, refused unsaved Test, saved Test, and CSP. Both modes save with JavaScript disabled. Screens at 1,200, 390 and 320 pixels have no horizontal overflow. This uses production routes/form/service/codec with a trusted local Admin fixture, memory store and controlled sender; it is not live production sign-in or remote delivery proof.

Coverage: one verified unit capture, 3,071 + 29 tests, source fingerprint `79bb06e8543006b80422a33c20724761b7fd7d7f9733883b72d782214b728fc3`, captured at `da8eab8f`; reused with matching identities after the document-only commit. [Coverage](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/coverage.json) · [Capture manifest](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/unit-capture-manifest.json). Final process completed all four stages, raw exit 1 for reviewed MI/test findings; standalone CRAP exits 0. The fresh worktree initially lacked ast-metrics/Go; an intact pinned installation was copied and verified by the installer before measurement. No tool failure remains. The narrow declaration emitter ignored unrelated diagnostics outside public modules; the separate full typecheck passed.

Not selected: PostgreSQL gate (store/SQL/config/lifetime unchanged), WorkOS live gate (auth and organization operations unchanged), separate renderer/search-live gates (pipeline unchanged; required offline renderer still ran inside the image). No production rollout or new legal approval is claimed.

GitHub returns **no checks or statuses** at the current head; local evidence is not called a remote CI pass. Earlier draft evidence is superseded by these candidate-bound reports.

## Quality review

**T1 Team review**, candidate **e77c075c3f8e37874dd89474e8a5f4f784f23e67** against **a7411fd02aa6dd3300b334d4585f71469071b499**. Generated architecture reason: **T0: no architecture fact**. The sole tier reason is `impact.sensitiveBehavior` for the local credential form and page-specific static-script permission. [Final checker](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/check-final.json) · [Bound impact](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/impact.json) · [Full manager review and retained reasons](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/quality-notes.md).

No architecture facts, policy questions, new dependencies, metric exceptions, skipped/todo tests, or forbidden edges. The checker's informational note, **48 public modules, 0 snapshots changed**, is verified. The form and parser are paired inside web; no separate supported portal/client protocol changes, so `contract=false` is appropriate. The underlying service, sender, stored None support and external integrations remain unchanged.

**Quality disposition.** The final process has Delta/Review goal misses and passing CRAP/Architecture stages. Raw process exit 1 is retained honestly; its reports are complete. [Process](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/process.md) · [Machine process](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/process.json) · [Review findings](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/review.json) · [CRAP](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/crap.json).

- Existing `logging-form.ts`: MI 69.5→65.7. Keep one short ordered boundary with CSRF-first and explicit input refusal guards. Complexity 13→16 is the medium finding; 100% measured coverage gives CRAP 16, below the changed-function limit of 30. A private selector predicate was considered but adds indirection for two fixed cases. The 15 target is mandatory only for new functions.
- Existing `logging-page.ts`: MI 72.6→69.0. Keep the single form, labels and field dependencies together; splitting template fragments would obscure the behavior. CRAP 8 at 98.4% coverage.
- Existing `members-page-layout.ts`: MI 83.0→81.0. Keep markup and matching CSP hashes under one owner; Members retains script denial. CRAP 7 at 99.8% coverage.
- `members-style.ts` is constant CSS, with no measured function/MI; browser layout review covers its warning box.
- High test-only finding: `logging-form.test.ts` MI 54.4→46.5. Retain focused scenario tables for the invalid-form contract. Tests have no production MI goal; moving assertions to generic helpers would reduce clarity. No production-file MI drop reaches five, and no new production file or changed function requires an exception.

Habit-hooks: exit 0, 30 retained findings, snooze `[]`. One form-complexity finding is covered above. Twenty-four non-null assertions are test preconditions: eight required DOM/header lookups, thirteen known route/header lookups, and three Set-Cookie checks; missing values fail those tests. Four comments explain the legacy tenant field, CSP ownership, or test evidence scope. The long acceptance file remains a cohesive specification of one protected settings page. [Per-file dispositions](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/implementation.md#habit-hooks-assessment).

Independent source review and manager review found no blocking defect. No-JS and real-browser behavior are verified. Legacy None rows need a Bearer upgrade for every Save, including disable, and before Test; this intentional compatibility limit is documented. Current saved Bearer credentials can remain blank for the same endpoint. Prior legal text and agreements are unchanged.

<details><summary>Architecture provenance and evidence limits</summary>

[Base registry](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a7411fd02aa6dd3300b334d4585f71469071b499/architecture/components.md) · [Candidate registry](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e77c075c3f8e37874dd89474e8a5f4f784f23e67/architecture/components.md) · [Assessment](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/0effcd80899b454c29356256645eaa08163e587d/ast-report/audit-destination-selector/architecture-review.json).

All 13 Mermaid blocks are byte-identical. Reviewed context, hosted containers, Audit settings/delivery, System/Audit ownership, runtime collaboration and deployment. Only web behavior prose changes. No new components, relationships, public callable contracts, containers or deployment boundaries; no L3 comparison or L4 detail is needed. The private layout script option stays inside web.

Unit-only architecture bands retain unknown/unchanged-function limits. Base CRAP derived from head coverage is an estimate. The embedded script string is not a separately measured TypeScript AST function; VM and real Chromium tests cover it. Screenshots/harness use local controlled identity/storage/sender, not production authentication. Full report provenance remains in the linked artifacts.

</details>

**Overall merge remains blocked pending independent authorized owner/team approval of this exact head and scope.** Agent review and the T1 label are technical evidence, not human approval. No PR #248 approval, de-escalation or exception is reused.
